column3: Exercise
Isn't that a strange way of thinking?
The opponents join under similar conditions. Even if I'm the bait or whatever, it's obvious that a unskillful player like me can only be a liability.
...Still whining?
My, my... Such poor judgment.
Kyousuke-shi really is slow...
What do you mean by that?
There is a reason for you to take part in the tournament, Kyousuke-shi. Cannon fodder or bait, these are just excuses!
Huhu, that's because Kiririn-shi and Kuroneko-shi aren't being honest.
...H-Hmph, you could have said that from the start. In that case I would've...
My, my... Kyousuke-shi really is dense.
Can't you hurry? It's about to start.
All right. Leave it to me.
After I finally gave up, Kirino and the rest immediately started training at Siscaly.
Kuroneko's expression completely changed the moment the game started.
She used the controller with such speed that I couldn't even see her fingers moving.
Kuroneko's character, "Alicia Blackcat", danced like butterflies as she went on the offensive against Kirino's character, "Tenjouin Mikoto".
Wow... It's completely different when you see an expert playing.
Although you pretend to be skillful, in truth you do not even measure up to me.
Ooh! As expected of the 【National Level】 Kuroneko-shi!
You're just a malicious and delusional girl. As always, you're "only skilled at video games".
She especially emphasized the word "only".
However, Kuroneko's moves are really good...
Aren't we extremely lucky to have her as an ally?
Do you not realize? Your moves, I know them like the back of my hand.
Ugh...
Hmph... Full of openings...
Hnng!
Well, it's about time you take a break.
Enjoy your sleep in despair!
This is... an overwhelming defeat.
Shall I go easy on you in the next game?
...Ghnnn...
Ah, ah. Kirino, she's glaring intensely at Kuroneko.
Kirino, I know that feeling well-
She threw the controller?! Moreover, why at me?!
It's your fault...
Huh?! Me?!
It's because you were dilly-dallying, it made me lose focus!
T-This is my fault?!
If I was serious... this evil girl...
Heh. For a weak beast, you sure bark a lot.
You say something?
I said that this is a loser's howl.
...Gnn-Hmph! Are you trying to taunt me?
Do you really think I'd take the bait?
Aren't you already...?
I'm not!
...Ah, hah... Damn, damn...!
This isn't good...
Hey, Kuroneko, let her win a round.
I must decline. Please do not interrupt me during a duel.
You two... It's merely a game, you're overreacting!
...Merely?
...A game?
Uwoh!
What do you mean it's merely a game? Do you still not understand?
This is a game, yet not a game. Have you still not realized that?
Well, well. The two of you don't need to be so fired up...
Hah!?
Kyousuke-shi is already repenting.
Anyway, what Kiririn-shi needs is to "calm down"!
I know that, even if you hadn't said it.
After that, we changed our pairings many times and trained hard, but there was no breakthrough.
Facing the national-level Kuroneko is out of question, but I still have trouble reading Kirino and Saori's moves.
After being humiliated for dozens of rounds, this time it's Kirino & Kuroneko vs Saori & myself.
No matter how you think about it, we should have no chance to win... However-
W-Wait! What are you doing?
You are in my way.
I'm just trying to help you!
I don't need your help. I will maintain control over the battlefield by myself.
Hah?!
Frankly speaking, you're nothing but a nuisance.
What's with that excuse!
Then how about having a 3-on-1 battle? I can release my sealed powers if there's nobody in my way.
...You really piss me off.
It's always like this...
In the end, they forgot about the controllers and the quarreling started.
With the two of them like that-
Take that! There!
The uncontrolled characters are then swiftly taken care of.
This memorable first victory, was brought to us by our two aces's ugly infighting.
You two... At least be friendly when you play together!
Although they socialize without reservation when playing games, when it comes to being on good terms outside of that...
There's something more to it, huh?
